knowledge.content: Echoes of Identity is a living archive designed to explore identity, memory, and personal reflection. It aims to preserve Jewish and Muslim stories across time, highlighting identity, immigration, culture, and discrimination. The project builds bridges between communities through shared history.

The current archive contains 41 distinct story pages based on the source material available. It represents 52 supplied narrative drafts; overlapping drafts are grouped within matching story pages. Collections cover Gaza, Djerba, the Tunisian Medina, La Goulette and Tunis, Russian-Jewish immigration, and additional Tunisian Jewish community interviews.

This website does not currently have a built-in story submission form. Read the contribution and consent information at /contribute, then contact info@echoesofidentity.org before sending a testimony or recording. The Join the Project application opens an external Google Form.
Online donation processing is not configured on this website. Contact info@echoesofidentity.org to ask about current ways to support the project.
The materials currently available do not verify a network of chapters or a complete list of project locations. For collaboration questions, contact info@echoesofidentity.org.
